1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves excessive vertical space before definition, theorem, and similar environments in LaTeX output generated by Quarto. This issue is caused by extra code prepended to these environments, specifically the `\leavevmode\vadjust pre{\hypertarget{def-def}{}}` line, which adds unwanted vertical space.
